name: Brown Rice Syrup
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as it's primarily glucose and maltose, which are absorbed in the small intestine before reaching bacterial overgrowth areas.
preparationTips: Use as a 1:1 substitute for honey in most recipes
Warm slightly to make pouring easier
Store in cool, dry place - may crystallize in cold temperatures
Mix well when using in cold applications like smoothies
alternatives: Stevia or monk fruit for calorie-free option
nutritionalHighlights: Provides quick energy from glucose and maltose
Contains small amounts of B vitamins from rice
Lower glycemic impact than regular sugar
Free from fructose, making it easier to digest
